outcome: radiologic changes (myometrial depth, width, residual myometrial thickness)
cohort: Women with an identified isthmocele who underwent robotic-assisted laparoscopic isthmocele repair between September 2015 and December 2022.
finding: Robotic-assisted laparoscopic isthmocele repair significantly improved isthmocele defect dimensions (depth, width, and residual myometrial thickness), resolved symptoms, and resulted in a high post-repair conception rate (94.1%) and live birth rate (80% of those who continued their pregnancies).
